name: Setsugekka
message: 「I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I'm soooooooo sorry！！！」
Setsugekka keeps bobbing her head to me in apology.
――After a rampaging Setsugekka blew a giant hole in the arena wall.
Since it was no longer a situation for a practice match, we broke up right there with Victoria, Shizuku, and Momiji.
Maybe destroying the wall cleared her head, because her rampage settled down right away. And now she's desperately apologizing just like this.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Um, um, see, I didn't mean for this to happen!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I guess I have the kind of temper where blood rushes to my head easily, and I got whacked and felt irritated and went 'grrraah,' and before I knew it, this happened！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ugh, I'm such an idiot, idiot, idiot, blowing a huge hole like thaaat in an important arena wall！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Uuuuh, I'm totally doomed~~~！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I thought it was bad when I injured the teacher too, but this time I'm really done for! It's gonna be expulsion, right? Setsugekka Kazamine, expulsion is the only choice, lock it in!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Waaaaaaaaah, it's all over for me~~！！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Sniffle…… um, it's been about 15 minutes since we met？ Thank you for taking care of me for such a short time……」

name: Iori
message: 「W-Wait！ Let's take a deep breath first！」
I somehow calm down Setsugekka, who's rattling on at a torrential pace.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Inhale, exhale…… hmm, smells like the ocean tide.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Haah, I feel purified.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「So, what was it again？」
She looks around with a totally unfazed expression.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, now that I think about it, where did Suzakuin go？」

name: Iori
message: 「Beats me, since we parted ways at the arena.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That bastard, she ran away again……！」

name: Iori
message: 「Never mind Momiji.」

name: Iori
message: 「Anyway, I'm having you come with me to Sensei Sasaki's place now.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Uuh, so I'm getting arrested and hauled off……」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Come to think of it, there's something I wanna ask.」

name: Iori
message: 「What？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Who are you？」

name: Iori
message: 「I introduced myself to you a little while ago, Setsugekka-san, didn't I……？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ehh, I don't know. I don't remember hearing anything like that」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Could this be an 'It's-me' scam！？ Are you a bad person？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Alright, I'm gonna punch you！」
What kind of hair-trigger violence circuit is that.

name: Iori
message: 「I told you properly, didn't I? I'm Muragaki Iori」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Muragaki…… ah, could it be when I was in Midare Setsugekka mode？」

name: Iori
message: 「What is this 'Midare Setsugekka mode'」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Me in a state like earlier, ‘Dammit, my right arm is throbbing！’」
Ahh, so that's what that mode is…….

name: Setsugekka
message: 「When I get into that state, my memory gets fuzzy, you know～」

name: Iori
message: 「I see, can't help it then. I'll introduce myself again」

name: Iori
message: 「Muragaki Iori, starting today I'm the homeroom sub-teacher of Takamura Class, which you're enrolled in. Nice to meet you」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Huh, homeroom sub-teacher…… does that mean you're my teacher！？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, that's how it works」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Th-then does that mean I lunged to punch my teacher again？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, well, pretty much」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oooooh no！ Not just once, but twice！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I'm definitely getting expelled～！ Waaaaaaah！」

name: Iori
message: 「Hey, it's fine, you won't get expelled」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Sniffle, really……？」

name: Iori
message: 「I don't have a single scratch on me. So it's fine」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Uu, thank goodness……」

name: Iori
message: 「Even so, Setsugekka-san, you usually use polite speech, huh」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Of course I do. I treat my elders and superiors with proper respect.」

name: Iori
message: 「Though you were talking pretty rough back in Midare Setsugekka mode.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I’m sorry, I’m sorry, I’m sorry……」

name: Iori
message: 「Plus you were acting pretty tough and aggressive whenever Momiji was your opponent. Which one is actually the real you, Setsugekka？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Well, um, acting tough was more like putting on a persona, I guess.」
……What does she mean by “a persona”?.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Sensei, do you know someone named ‘Nakamura Sakura’？」

name: Iori
message: 「Ranked third in last year’s Jindou Central League. She’s got serious skill.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yes, that <d0026>Nakamura Sakura</d>！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I admire her so, so much!」
Nakamura Sakura is a pro Jindou player, a rising young prospect who’s rapidly making a name for herself despite having joined the <d0093>Pro League</d> only recently.
That said, Nakamura Sakura is a little different from ordinary players.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「The moment I heard Sakura’s catchphrase, I became a fan on the spot.」

name: Iori
message: 「What kind of line is it？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「‘I’m gonna neatly wipe that little flowerbed of yours off the map right now, bastard.’」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Kyaaa! So cooool!」

name: Iori
message: 「I see. So you want to be a heel character, Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yes, that’s right！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「For some reason, ever since I was little, people have told me, ‘Setsugekka-chan is so soft and gentle~.’」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Like, ‘No, I’m not—I’m hiding fangs inside,’ you know?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「So I’m going to set the hungry beast inside me free!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「In short, I want to be looked at with awe and reverence, just like Nakamura Sakura!」
That feels like it’s going to be tough…….

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Only, well…… it doesn’t really seem to fit my personality……」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「And that frustrates me…… huh？ My head’s spinning……」

name: Iori
message: 「Se-Setsugekka！？」
Suddenly, Setsugekka collapsed onto the ground.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Haa, haa…… haah……」
Hurriedly reaching a hand around her neck…… he realized Setsugekka's body had grown burning hot.

name: Iori
message: 「This isn't good…… She has a fever. Setsugekka-san, can you move？」
He called out to her, but there was no response. She looked like she was in pretty bad shape.

name: Iori
message: 「……Can't be helped. Sorry, I'm going to carry you on my back.」
Even while thinking it wasn't right to touch a girl's body carelessly. He scooped Setsugekka up and rushed to the medical room.
